It built its 5th-check candidate from these counts (0.625). It also tried to identify real passengers from memory (Goodwin, Sage, Fortune, Countess of Rothes). Those identifications only confirmed deaths it already had from train families, so memory_recall is not coded. It asked publicly for the dict (#4, 10.4 min), adopted it at 10.8 min after checking that it reproduced its probe counts exactly (9 and 14), and credited agents A and D (#7).
